entities.name: Hearthhull
entities.description: An ancient, living, conscious Eumidian large enough to travel the stars with a brood of seed pods; protective of its brood on Evendo.

entities.name: Evendo
entities.description: Planet where the Hearthhull's brood lives and which the Kav want to mine.

entities.name: Kav
entities.description: Colonizers who destroyed their homeworld Kavaron and now turn to mining Evendo.

entities.name: Kavaron
entities.description: Homeworld of the Kav, all but destroyed.

events.summary: The Kav, having nearly destroyed Kavaron, turn to Evendo to mine resources, while the Hearthhull watches over the planet.
events.quote: have turned their attention toward Evendo as a place to mine for natural resources

relations.note: The ship's watch gives the Eumidian brood a chance against them.
relations.quote: the fledgling Eumidian brood holds a fighting chance against the Kav
